owner_creation.analysis: size_metachars: The private c_int owns malloc capacity metadata, initially zero, then sixteen or twice the previous capacity during add_metachar growth.
owner_creation.invariant: Capacity counts bytes including space for the terminator.
limitations: Current helper buffers remain raw C-shaped owners; unchecked growth/numeric arithmetic is recorded under M0-MEM-001, without claiming a demonstrated runtime failure.
